primary_display_name_zh: 克娄巴特拉七世·菲洛帕托尔

death.conversion_note: Died in Alexandria; cause of death disputed (asp/snake bite is ancient tradition, not certain fact)

short_description_en: Last active ruler of Ptolemaic Egypt (r. 51-30 BCE). Formed alliances with Julius Caesar and Mark Antony; mother of Caesarion. Defeated by Octavian at the Battle of Actium (31 BCE). Her death marked the end of the Ptolemaic dynasty and Egypt's absorption into the Roman Empire.
short_description_zh: 托勒密埃及最后一位实际统治者（前51-30年在位）。与凯撒和马克·安东尼结盟，凯撒里昂之母。在亚克兴海战（前31年）中被屋大维击败。其死亡标志着托勒密王朝终结，埃及并入罗马帝国版图。
